what: Swamp biome hero tree: stilt roots and a flat-topped canopy, a landmark the player can shelter under.

dims.basis: measured from exported GLB; 1.75x player height

views.why: seen from the 45/30 isometric camera as a biome landmark

style_notes: Low-Poly Diorama: chunky, faceted, flat-shaded, saturated accent colours, readable at ~60 px. Palette-only (docs/ART_DIRECTION.md), no textures, no smooth shading. 1 tile = 1 u; player = 1.55 u; storey = 2.5 u; doors 0.9 x 2.0 u. Base at z=0, centred on (0,0). Never: smooth normals, external textures, invented hues, hidden geometry nobody sees.
notes: Hero finishing: bevelled silhouette parts, weighted normals, flat shading, smart UV pack; 460 tris. Crown widened, seam capped and feet grounded after the critic rounds.
